title: Balsa Vuckovic Handed Two-Game Suspension at the World Aquatics Men’s Water Polo World Cup – Final 2026
text: Balsa Vuckovic Handed Two-Game Suspension at the World Aquatics Men’s Water Polo World Cup – Final 2026 03 August 2026, Lausanne - The Aquatics Integrity Unit (AQIU) has issued a two-game suspension to Montenegrin Player Balsa Vuckovic for violent action. The incident occurred during the Classification Match between Spain and Montenegro on 25 July 2026, at the World Aquatics Men’s Water Polo World Cup 2026 – Final, in Sydney, Australia.
